If PathFileComparisonCounter on that name returns 1 and dword_7D032C equals 1, it builds a path from dword_5EC418 (fallback byte_5EA438) plus aWinconstructor via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck and loads it with FileLoadWithRetryLoop. Always calls ScoringClassificationDisplay and returns 0.
